At least one Google agent framework is present
Google Cloud infrastructure is implemented and deployment is proven
The project clearly fits The Taskmaster workflow track
README contains reproducible local and cloud-oriented spin-up instructions
A clear architecture diagram is ready for judges
A tight unedited approximately four-minute demo proves the product and cloud runtime
Cloud Run, Firestore, GCS, persistent evidence and a real Gemini call are visibly proven

criteria.label: Innovation & Operational Utility
criteria.reason: HealthIA now combines adaptive Gemini-generated five-question clinical blocks with demand-selected specialist tools, patient-owned longitudinal state, multimodal identification/extraction for uploaded laboratory reports and clinical imaging/report formats, a provenance-linked clinical twin, and conversational retrieval that can return to an older requested study instead of blindly using the latest result. The workflow is event-driven rather than timer-driven and preserves the original evidence. The remaining utility gap is one judge-visible action that reaches a verified outcome beyond analysis and closes its mission.

criteria.label: Architectural Discipline & Tech Stack
criteria.reason: The system now has typed longitudinal state, deterministic safety, consent/audit controls, guarded Gemini calls, event-driven SSE UI, no permanent server/browser polling loop, one-use patient-bound device pairing identities, atomic result-plus-original evidence commits, Firestore state, patient-scoped Cloud Storage evidence, Cloud Run provisioning and a strict Cloud proof gate. Google ADK is still not the primary visible runtime, authenticated multi-patient isolation and durable device credentials across Cloud Run restarts remain unproven, and no actual Cloud trace has yet been captured.

criteria.label: Demo & Production Readiness
criteria.reason: A clean hosted runner has already installed Chromium, passed the Python suite, fourteen full API/state workflows, real-browser E2E, compilation, smoke, Judge Ω, JavaScript and PowerShell syntax, deterministic release ZIP verification and a second pytest run from the extracted release. New cloud tooling additionally defines an evidence-based Cloud Run + Firestore + GCS + live Gemini + multimodal + twin round-trip gate. Those new cloud changes still need the latest CI run and a real authenticated Google Cloud execution; there is no final video or judge package yet.

critical_blockers.statement: The Google ADK coordinator must select and execute the same tools used by the visible patient workflow rather than remain a structurally separate demo agent.
critical_blockers.evidence_needed: One correlated trace showing patient/event input, ADK decision, selected tools, persisted evidence and public result/closure.

critical_blockers.statement: Pairing tokens are now patient/device/connection bound, but authenticated multi-patient isolation and device credential durability across Cloud Run restarts are not proven.
critical_blockers.evidence_needed: Two isolated synthetic identities plus restart/reconnect proof showing one identity cannot read or sync into the other.

critical_blockers.statement: The system can collect, interpret, retrieve and follow longitudinal evidence, but the submission still needs one Taskmaster-style action that reaches a verified synthetic outcome and closes its mission.
critical_blockers.evidence_needed: A correlated end-to-end mission with evidence IDs, tool action, patient/external feedback, persisted result and completed closure state.

critical_blockers.statement: Cloud Run, Firestore, GCS and Gemini now have a strict verification path but have not yet been executed with authenticated Google Cloud credentials for this repository.
critical_blockers.evidence_needed: Cloud Run URL/revision, deployment/cloud-proof-latest.json, Firestore update, GCS generation and live Gemini request evidence.

critical_blockers.statement: The final architecture diagram, unedited demo, write-up and submission evidence are not assembled.
critical_blockers.evidence_needed: Final judge package matching the official submission checklist.

next_actions: Make Google ADK the visible demand-driven mission runtime and emit structured public tool results.
Run the strict Cloud deployment proof on the authenticated Google Cloud project and preserve the evidence artifact.
Prove two-identity isolation plus one closed-loop Taskmaster mission, then record the final demo.
